text:
Maya: quick day6 check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Maya: done: matched the devcontainer image, pulled dependencies, ran unit tests locally (all green). spun up the app and hit the health endpoint. :white_check_mark:
Maya: blocker: trying to build the production image for the sample service but docker login to our private registry fails because MFA is enforced for org accounts. getting `unauthorized: authentication required` even after `docker login` with personal token.
Maya: also raised a small PR for the onboarding README (PR #12) but seems to be in the contributors queue awaiting CLA signoff — not sure who to ping for that.
Maya: today: unblock registry login, get PR through, start pairing on the staging deployment workflow.

Sam: @Maya nice progress — for the registry MFA we use the gcloud credential helper for images in GCR and `docker-credential-ecr-login` for ECR. Which registry are you hitting?

Maya: hitting `registry.redwood-inference.internal` (we host images in our private Harbor cluster).

Sam: ah Harbor — we enforce SSO + MFA, so you need to generate a short-lived robot token. I can request one for your account, or you can use the cli we provide: `onboardctl fetch-robot-token`.

Sam: try this flow:

```bash
# get robot token (one-time, TTL 1h)
onboardctl fetch-robot-token --service harbor --user maya@example.com
# configure docker credential helper
docker login registry.redwood-inference.internal --username robot-maya --password-stdin
```

Sam: if `onboardctl` errors, paste the output here and I'll escalate to infra.

OnboardBot: Maya, GCP project access granted: project/redwood-devops (roles: viewer, storage.objectViewer). See https://console.cloud.google.com/ for details. :robot_face:

Amira: @Maya I can also nudge infra for the CLA if you want — who did you invite to sign? usually the bot posts a link in the PR but sometimes it stalls.

Maya: thanks @Sam — running the `onboardctl` command now. hitting `permission denied` when it tries to call the secrets API. full output: `error: rpc permission denied: secrets.get`

Sam: okay that's the secrets API RL — sounds like the service-account binding didn't finish. can you run `gcloud auth list` and paste the active account? also i'll open a quick infra ticket.

Maya: active account is `maya@redwood.com`.

Sam: perfect. pinging infra and adding the ticket link here: https://go/redwood/infra/INC-4821 — they usually resolve secrets bindings in < 2 hours. in the meantime, you can ask me for a temp robot token and i'll generate it for you. :thumbsup:

Amira: PR side — I looked up PR #12, CLA bot shows `pending` and the author email doesn't match redwood SSO. two options: confirm you pushed commits with your `@redwood.com` email or sign the CLA manually via the link in the PR. want me to update the author/committer?

Maya: I pushed from my laptop where my git config used personal email accidentally. I can modify the commits to use my work email. what's the simplest?

Amira: quick route: do an interactive rebase to amend email on the last 2 commits then force-push. e.g.:

```bash
git rebase -i HEAD~2
# mark commits 'edit' then:
git commit --amend --author="Maya <maya@redwood.com>" --no-edit
git rebase --continue
git push --force-with-lease origin maya/onboarding-readme
```

Amira: alternatively I can trigger the CLA override if infra needs time. your call.

Maya: rebase+amend sounds fine, i'll do that after infra ticket updates.

Sam: FYI once infra fixes the secrets binding you'll be able to run `onboardctl` end-to-end and then generate long-lived creds for dev use. for now i'll create a temp robot token and DM it to you so you can continue the Docker flow.

OnboardBot: INFRA ticket INC-4821 updated: attached logs and assigned to @tom-infra. ETA 90m.

Maya: thanks everyone — small asks for the day: 1) temp robot token (Sam) 2) help with rebase if it goes sideways (Amira) 3) confirm once secrets binding is fixed (Sam/Infra). I'll post back here after I get the image built. :coffee:

Sam: got it. sending DM with token now. good luck! :rocket:

Amira: ping if you want a walkthrough on the rebase. happy to pair. :heart:

Maya: update @here — token worked, image built, pushed to registry, CI started. going to watch the deploy and then start on the staging smoke tests. small follow-up: please keep an eye on PR #12 for CLA status.

OnboardBot: CI pipeline started for `maya/onboarding-readme` (pipeline #214).

Maya: last note: one flaky unit test failed intermittently (`tests/test-config-loader::test_env_override`) — looks like a timing issue with file watcher. i'll file a tiny ticket if it reproduces.

Sam: great wrap-up. thanks for the check-in! :clap:
